findings.passage: We write to urge you to veto Substitute Senate Bill 293 which needlessly and recklessly changes Ohio voting laws to yet again add administrative barriers for Ohio citizens to cast their vote and have it counted. SB 293 eliminates the four-day grace period for timely mailed ballots to be received by Boards of Elections after election day and creates additional mechanisms to cancel voter registrations.
findings.note: Co-signed letter from House minority members to the Governor asking for a veto of SB 293 (mail-ballot receipt deadline and registration cancellation using other agencies' databases, which the bill ties to citizenship checks). Signed by Veronica R. Sims with many colleagues; a shared statement, not written by this person alone.
